reviewed_by: Automated static review (Binary Ninja + Radare2 CFG, signature, behaviour note)

runtime_contract.note: Typed pre-resume replay over all 256 signed-byte inputs; six app-context fields are captured before and after each call in retail and candidate.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both identify a single function entry at 0x0048F1A0 with matching CFG node and edge sets (recorded similarity 1.000); the candidate implements that entry.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The chunk tag constants, the node offsets and the record sizes are the literal values the retail instructions compare and read.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The candidate takes the retail's arguments in the retail's order: the chunk list or form and the searched tag for the searches, and the chunk for the payload.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The candidate performs the retail's sibling and child walk and returns the retail's null or payload pointer; it has no other side effect.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The candidate reads the retail data as it is stored; it performs no float arithmetic.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The chunk node layout and the payload offsets are the ones the retail instructions read, and the port reads the same fields.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The candidate returns the retail's null for a missing chunk and the retail's payload pointer for a found one, on the same branches as the retail code.
